document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const loader = document.getElementById('loader');
    const themeToggle = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
    const menuBtn = document.querySelector('.menu-btn');
    const nav = document.querySelector('nav');
    const header = document.querySelector('header');
    const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section, .hero-content');
    const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');

    const setTheme = (theme) => {
        document.body.classList.toggle('light-theme', theme === 'light');
        document.body.classList.toggle('dark-theme', theme === 'dark');
        if (themeToggle) themeToggle.textContent = theme === 'light' ? '☀️' : '🌙';
        localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
    };

    const preferredTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme') || (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches ? 'light' : 'dark');
    setTheme(preferredTheme);

    if (themeToggle) {
        themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const nextTheme = document.body.classList.contains('light-theme') ? 'dark' : 'light';
            setTheme(nextTheme);
        });
    }

    if (menuBtn && nav) {
        menuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            nav.classList.toggle('open');
        });
    }

    if (nav) {
        nav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((link) => {
            link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                nav.classList.remove('open');
            });
        });
    }

    const revealOnScroll = () => {
        window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            sections.forEach((section) => {
                const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (rect.top < window.innerHeight - 100) {
                    section.classList.add('active');
                }
            });

            if (header) {
                if (window.scrollY > 30) {
                    header.classList.add('scrolled');
                } else {
                    header.classList.remove('scrolled');
                }
            }
        });
    };

    const updateProgress = () => {
        if (!progressBar) return;
        const scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
        const scrollHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
        const clientHeight = document.documentElement.clientHeight;
        const percent = Math.min((scrollTop / Math.max(scrollHeight - clientHeight, 1)) * 100, 100);
        progressBar.style.width = `${percent}%`;
    };

    window.addEventListener('scroll', revealOnScroll);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', updateProgress);
    window.addEventListener('resize', revealOnScroll);

    if (loader) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            loader.classList.add('hide');
        }, 650);
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
        revealOnScroll();
        updateProgress();
    }, 750);
});
/* ==========================================
   THE DAYS WE NEVER KNEW
   Official Website CSS
   Part 1
========================================== */

:root{
    --bg:#d8c3a5;
    --surface:#fcf7ee;
    --surface-alt:#1f2937;
    --text:#000000;
    --muted:#d1d5db;
    --primary:#d8c3a5;
    --primary-hover:#fcf7ee;
    --border:#a67c52;
    --nav-bg:rgba(10,10,10,.45);
    --overlay:rgba(0,0,0,.65);
}

body.dark-theme{
    
    --bg:#0d1117;
    --surface:#111827;
    --surface-alt:#1f2937;
    --text:#000000;
    --muted:#d1d5db;
    --primary:#4f46e5;
    --primary-hover:#6366f1;
    --border:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    --nav-bg:rgba(10,10,10,.45);
    --overlay:rgba(0,0,0,.65);
}

body.light-theme{
    --bg:#f8fafc;
    --surface:#e2e8f0;
    --surface-alt:#cbd5e1;
    --text:#000000;
    --muted:#475569;
    --primary:#4f46e5;
    --primary-hover:#4338ca;
    --border:rgba(15,23,42,.13);
    --nav-bg:rgba(248,250,252,.95);
    --overlay:rgba(255,255,255,.70);
}

*{
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
    scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
    font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    overflow-x:hidden;
}

body.light-theme{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
} 

/* Scrollbar */

::-webkit-scrollbar{
    width:10px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track{
    background:#111827;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{
    background:#4f46e5;
    border-radius:20px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{
    background:#6366f1;
}

/* ===========================
   VINTAGE PAPER THEME
=========================== */

body{

margin:0;
padding:0;

font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;

color:#3b2a1a;

background:
linear-gradient(rgba(255,248,230,.88),rgba(255,248,230,.88)),
url("images/old-paper.jpg");

background-size:cover;

background-attachment:fixed;

background-position:center;

background-repeat:no-repeat;

}

/* ==========================================
   HERO SECTION
========================================== */

.hero{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    height:100vh;
    background:url("images/bg.JPG") center center/cover no-repeat;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    text-align:center;
}

.overlay{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);
}

.hero-content{

animation:cinematic 1.8s ease-out;

}

@keyframes cinematic{

0%{

opacity:0;

transform:translateY(80px) scale(.95);

}

60%{

opacity:.7;

}

100%{

opacity:1;

transform:translateY(0) scale(1);

}

}

.hero h1{

font-size:70px;

font-family:'Cinzel',serif;

letter-spacing:3px;

animation:titleZoom 2s ease;

}

@keyframes titleZoom{

0%{

opacity:0;

transform:scale(.7);

}

100%{

opacity:1;

transform:scale(1);

}

}

.hero p{

font-size:22px;

max-width:750px;

margin:auto;

line-height:1.8;

animation:fadeUp 2.5s ease;

}

@keyframes fadeUp{

from{

opacity:0;

transform:translateY(40px);

}

to{

opacity:1;

transform:translateY(0);

}

}
.read-btn{
    display:inline-block;
    text-decoration:none;
    background:#4f46e5;
    color:#fff;
    padding:16px 42px;
    border-radius:50px;
    font-size:18px;
    font-weight:600;
    transition:.35s;
    box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(79,70,229,.45);
}

.read-btn:hover{
    transform:translateY(-5px);
    background:#6366f1;
    box-shadow:0 12px 35px rgba(99,102,241,.55);
}

/* Animations */

@keyframes fadeDown{
    from{
        opacity:0;
        transform:translateY(-50px);
    }
    to{
        opacity:1;
        transform:translateY(0);
    }
}

@keyframes fadeUp{
    from{
        opacity:0;
        transform:translateY(50px);
    }
    to{
        opacity:1;
        transform:translateY(0);
    }
}

.reveal{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(40px);
    visibility:hidden;
    transition:opacity .8s ease, transform .8s ease, visibility .8s ease;
}

.reveal.active{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0);
    visibility:visible;
}

/* ==========================================
   ABOUT SECTION
========================================== */

.about{
    padding:100px 8%;
    background:var(--surface);
}

.container{
    max-width:1200px;
    margin:auto;
    text-align:center;
}

.about h2{
    font-family:'Cinzel', serif;
    font-size:42px;
    margin-bottom:25px;
}

.about p{
    max-width:850px;
    margin:0 auto;
    color:var(--muted);
    line-height:1.9;
    font-size:18px;
}

/* Stats */

.stats{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));
    gap:25px;
    margin-top:60px;
}

.card{
    background:var(--surface-alt);
    border-radius:18px;
    padding:35px 20px;
    transition:.35s;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-10px);
    box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(79,70,229,.30);
    border-color:var(--primary);
}

.card h3{
    font-size:40px;
    color:#818cf8;
    margin-bottom:12px;
}

.card span{
    color:var(--text);
    font-size:17px;
}

/* ==========================================
   CHAPTER SECTION
========================================== */

.chapters{
    padding:100px 8%;
    background:var(--bg);
}

.chapters h2{
    text-align:center;
    font-family:'Cinzel',serif;
    font-size:42px;
    margin-bottom:55px;
}

.chapter-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));
    gap:30px;
}

.chapter-card{

        background:rgba(255,250,240,.88);

        backdrop-filter:blur(8px);

        border:2px solid #b08d57;

        border-radius:18px;

        box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.18);

}

.chapter-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-10px);
    border-color:var(--primary);
    box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(99,102,241,.25);
}

.chapter-card h3{
    font-size:28px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
}

.chapter-card p{
    color:var(--muted);
    margin-bottom:25px;
}

.chapter-card a{
    display:inline-block;
    text-decoration:none;
    background:var(--primary);
    color:var(--text);
    padding:12px 28px;
    border-radius:40px;
    transition:.3s;
}

.chapter-card a:hover{
    background:#fcf7ee;
    color:#2d241b;
    border: 1px solid #b08d57;
}
/* ==========================================
   CHARACTERS SECTION
========================================== */

.characters{
    padding:100px 8%;
    background:var(--surface);
}

.characters h2{
    text-align:center;
    font-family:'Cinzel',serif;
    font-size:42px;
    margin-bottom:60px;
}

.character-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));
    gap:30px;
}

.character-card{
    background:var(--surface-alt);
    border-radius:20px;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-align:center;
    transition:.35s;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.character-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-10px);
    box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(99,102,241,.25);
    border-color:#6366f1;
}

.character-card img{
    width:100%;
    height:320px;
    object-fit:cover;
}

.character-card h3{
    margin-top:20px;
    font-size:28px;
}

.character-card p{
    padding:15px 20px 30px;
    color:var(--muted);
    line-height:1.7;
}
.read-btn{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);
    color:white;
    border-radius:40px;
    padding:14px 30px;
    text-decoration:none;
    font-weight:bold;
    transition:.3s;
}
.character-btn{

background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b08d57,#8b5e3c);

color:white;

border-radius:40px;

padding:14px 30px;

text-decoration:none;

font-weight:bold;

transition:.3s;

}

.read-btn:hover,
.character-btn:hover{

transform:translateY(-5px);

}
/*==========================================
        PREMIUM CHARACTER PROFILE
==========================================*/
.premium-character-profile{
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:2;
  color:#333;
  text-align:justify;
}

.premium-character-profile ul{
  list-style:none;
  padding:0;
}

.premium-character-profile .card{
  background:#fffdf8;
  padding:14px 18px;
  margin:12px 0;
  border-left:6px solid #8b5e3c;
  border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  transition:.3s;
}

.premium-character-profile .card:hover{
  transform:translateX(8px);
}

.premium-character-profile .meta{
  margin-top:40px;
  padding:30px;
  background:#fff6e8;
  border-left:8px solid #8b5e3c;
  font-size:24px;
  font-style:italic;
  text-align:center;
  border-radius:15px;
  color:#4b3621;
}

.premium-character-profile .actions{
  margin-top:45px;
  display:flex;
  justify-content:center;
}

.premium-character-profile .cta{
  padding:15px 35px;
  background:#8b5e3c;
  color:#fff;
  text-decoration:none;
  border-radius:40px;
  font-weight:bold;
  transition:.3s;
}

.premium-character-profile .cta:hover{
  background:#6f4a2f;
  transform:translateY(-5px);
}
/*==========================================
        CHARACTERS PAGE
==========================================*/

.premium-characters-page{

padding:120px 20px;

text-align:center;

}

.premium-characters-page h1{

font-size:48px;

margin-bottom:15px;

color:#5a3d2b;

}

.premium-characters-page p{

font-size:18px;

margin-bottom:50px;

}

.premium-character-grid{

display:grid;

grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));

gap:30px;

max-width:1200px;

margin:auto;

}

.premium-character-card{

background:#fcf7ee;

padding:25px;

border-radius:20px;

border:2px solid #b08d57;

box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.15);

transition:.3s;

}

.premium-character-card:hover{

transform:translateY(-10px);

}

.premium-character-card img{

width:170px;

height:170px;

border-radius:50%;

object-fit:cover;

border:5px solid #8b5e3c;

margin-bottom:20px;

}

.premium-character-card h2{

color:#5a3d2b;

margin-bottom:10px;

}

.premium-character-card p{

margin-bottom:20px;

}
/* ==========================================
        PREMIUM CHARACTER PROFILE
==========================================*/
.premium-character-profile{

max-width:1000px;

margin:120px auto 60px;

padding:50px;

background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fcf8ef,#f4ead7);

border-radius:25px;

border:3px solid #b08d57;

box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.25);

animation:fadeIn 1s ease;

}

.premium-character-profile .profile-img{

display:block;

width:240px;

height:240px;

margin:-140px auto 30px;

border-radius:50%;

object-fit:cover;

border:8px solid #fff;

box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.35);

transition:.4s;

}

.premium-character-profile .profile-img:hover{

transform:scale(1.08) rotate(2deg);

}

.premium-character-profile h1{

text-align:center;

font-size:52px;

color:#5a3d2b;

font-family:'Cinzel',serif;

margin-bottom:10px;

letter-spacing:3px;

}

.premium-character-profile .role{

text-align:center;

font-size:22px;

color:#8b5e3c;

font-style:italic;

margin-bottom:35px;

}

.premium-character-profile h2{

margin-top:35px;

margin-bottom:15px;

font-size:30px;

color:#5a3d2b;

padding-bottom:8px;

border-bottom:3px solid #b08d57;

}

.premium-character-profile p{

font-size:18px;

line-height:2;

color:#333;

text-align:justify;

}

.premium-character-profile ul{

list-style:none;

padding:0;

}

.premium-character-profile li{

background:#fffdf8;

padding:14px 18px;

margin:12px 0;

border-left:6px solid #8b5e3c;

border-radius:10px;

box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.08);

transition:.3s;

}

.premium-character-profile li:hover{

transform:translateX(8px);

}

.premium-character-profile blockquote{

margin-top:40px;

padding:30px;

background:#fff6e8;

border-left:8px solid #8b5e3c;

font-size:24px;

font-style:italic;

text-align:center;

border-radius:15px;

color:#4b3621;

}

.premium-character-profile .chapter-navigation{

margin-top:45px;

display:flex;

justify-content:center;

}

.premium-character-profile .nav-btn{

padding:15px 35px;

background:#8b5e3c;

color:#fff;

text-decoration:none;

border-radius:40px;

font-weight:bold;

transition:.3s;

}

.premium-character-profile .nav-btn:hover{

background:#6f4a2f;

transform:translateY(-5px);

box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.25);

}

@keyframes fadeIn{

from{

opacity:0;

transform:translateY(40px);

}

to{

opacity:1;

transform:translateY(0);

}

}

@media(max-width:768px){

.premium-character-profile .character-profile{

margin:80px 15px;

padding:25px;

}

.premium-character-profile .profile-img{

width:170px;

height:170px;

margin-top:-100px;

}

.premium-character-profile h1{

font-size:36px;

}

.premium-character-profile h2{

font-size:24px;

}

.premium-character-profile p,
.premium-character-profile li{

font-size:16px;

}

}
/* ==========================================
   CONTACT
========================================== */

.contact{
    padding:100px 8%;
    text-align:center;
    background:var(--bg);
}

.contact h2{
    font-family:'Cinzel',serif;
    font-size:40px;
    margin-bottom:20px;
}

.contact p{
    max-width:750px;
    margin:auto;
    color:var(--muted);
    line-height:1.8;
    font-size:18px;
}
/* CONTACT FORM */

.contact-form{

    max-width:650px;
    margin:40px auto 0;

    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:20px;

}

.contact-form input,
.contact-form textarea{

    width:100%;
    padding:16px 18px;

    border:2px solid #b08d57;
    border-radius:12px;

    background:#fffdf8;

    font-size:16px;

    outline:none;

    transition:.3s;

}

.contact-form input:focus,
.contact-form textarea:focus{

    border-color:#8b5e3c;
    box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(139,94,60,.25);

}

.contact-form textarea{

    resize:vertical;

}

.contact-form button{

    padding:16px;

    border:none;

    border-radius:12px;

    background:#8b5e3c;

    color:#fff;

    font-size:18px;

    font-weight:600;

    cursor:pointer;

    transition:.3s;

}

.contact-form button:hover{

    background:#6f4a2f;

    transform:translateY(-3px);

}
.chapter-card,   
.character-card,
.contact-box{

background:rgba(255,250,240,.88);

backdrop-filter:blur(8px);

border:2px solid #b08d57;

border-radius:18px;

box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.18);

}
/* ==========================================
   FOOTER
========================================== */

footer{
    background:var(--surface-alt);
    padding:30px;
    text-align:center;
    border-top:1px solid var(--border);
}

footer p{
    color:var(--muted);
    font-size:15px;
}

/* Chapter page */

.chapter-header{
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    z-index:1000;
    background:rgba(13,17,23,.95);
    backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}

.chapter-header nav{
    max-width:1200px;
    margin:auto;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:20px;
    padding:18px 40px;
}

.chapter-header .logo img{
    width:44px;
    height:44px;
}

.chapter-header ul{
    display:flex;
    gap:25px;
    list-style:none;
}

.chapter-header ul li a{
    color:var(--text);
    text-decoration:none;
    font-weight:500;
    transition:.25s;
}

.chapter-header ul li a:hover{
    color:var(--primary);
}

#progressBar{
    position:fixed;
    top:0;
    left:0;
    width:0;
    height:4px;
    background:var(--primary);
    z-index:1100;
    transition:width .2s ease;
}

.chapter-hero{
    padding:140px 10% 80px;
    text-align:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13,17,23,.95), rgba(13,17,23,.8));
    color:var(--text);
}

.chapter-hero h1{
    font-family:'Cinzel',serif;
    font-size:52px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
}

.chapter-hero h2{
    font-size:28px;
    margin-bottom:18px;
    color:var(--primary);
}

.chapter-hero p{
    max-width:780px;
    margin:auto;
    color:var(--muted);
    line-height:1.8;
    font-size:18px;
}

.reading-area{
    padding:60px 12%;
    background:var(--bg);
}

.novel-paper{
    max-width:980px;
    margin:auto;
    background:var(--surface);
    border-radius:30px;
    padding:40px 50px;
    box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.16);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.novel-paper h3,
.novel-paper h2{
    font-family:'Cinzel',serif;
}

.novel-paper h3{
    font-size:28px;
    margin-bottom:20px;
    color:var(--primary);
}

.novel-paper h2{
    margin-top:40px;
    font-size:34px;
}

.novel-paper .chapter-date{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    margin:18px 0 28px;
    padding:12px 18px;
    background:rgba(79,70,229,.12);
    border-radius:999px;
    color:var(--text);
    font-weight:500;
}

.novel-paper p{
    color:var(--muted);
    line-height:1.9;
    margin-top:18px;
    font-size:18px;
}

.novel-paper hr{
    border:none;
    height:1px;
    margin:34px 0;
    background:var(--border);
}

.opening-quote{
    margin:24px 0 16px;
    padding:24px 30px;
    border-left:4px solid var(--primary);
    color:var(--text);
    background:rgba(79,70,229,.08);
    font-size:20px;
    line-height:1.9;
    border-radius:18px;
}

@media (max-width:900px){
    .chapter-header nav,
    .chapter-hero,
    .reading-area{
        padding-left:20px;
        padding-right:20px;
    }

    .novel-paper{
        padding:30px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width:768px){
    .chapter-header ul{
        gap:14px;
        flex-wrap:wrap;
    }
}

/* ==========================================
   RESPONSIVE
========================================== */

@media (max-width:768px){

nav{
    padding:18px 20px;
}

nav ul{
    display:none;
}

.menu-btn{
    display:block;
}

.hero-content h1{
    font-size:38px;
}

.hero-content p{
    font-size:16px;
}

.about h2,
.chapters h2,
.characters h2,
.contact h2{
    font-size:32px;
}

.logo h2{
    font-size:18px;
}

.logo img{
    width:45px;
    height:45px;
}

}
/*==========================================
    CHAPTER NAVIGATION
==========================================*/

.chapter-navigation{

display:flex;

justify-content:center;

align-items:center;

gap:20px;

flex-wrap:wrap;

margin-top:60px;

}

.nav-btn{

display:inline-block;

padding:14px 30px;

background:#4f46e5;

color:#fff;

text-decoration:none;

font-weight:600;

border-radius:50px;

transition:.35s;

box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(79,70,229,.30);

}
.nav-btn:hover{

background:#6366f1;

transform:translateY(-5px);

box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(99,102,241,.40);

}

.nav-btn.disabled{

background:#6b7280;

pointer-events:none;

cursor:not-allowed;

box-shadow:none;

}

/*==========================================
    CHAPTER FOOTER
==========================================*/

.chapter-footer{

background:#090c10;

padding:35px;

text-align:center;

border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);

}

.chapter-footer p{

color:#9ca3af;

font-size:15px;

}

/*==========================================
      MOBILE READING
==========================================*/

@media(max-width:768px){

.chapter-hero{

padding:120px 20px 60px;

}

.chapter-hero h1{

font-size:38px;

}

.chapter-hero h2{

font-size:22px;

}

.chapter-hero p{

font-size:16px;

}

.novel-paper{

padding:30px 22px;

border-radius:15px;

}

.novel-paper h2{

font-size:28px;

}

.novel-paper h3{

font-size:24px;

}

.novel-paper p{

font-size:17px;

line-height:2;

}

.opening-quote{

font-size:18px;

}

.chapter-navigation{

flex-direction:column;

gap:15px;

}

.nav-btn{

width:100%;

text-align:center;

}

}
/*==========================================
        PREMIUM START READING BUTTON
==========================================*/

.read-btn{

display:inline-block;

margin-top:35px;

padding:18px 45px;

font-size:20px;

font-weight:700;

text-decoration:none;

color:#fff;

background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b08d57,#8b5e3c);

border-radius:50px;

box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.30);

transition:.35s;

animation:glow 2s infinite;

}

.read-btn:hover{

transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.05);

box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);

background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c79a5b,#6f4a2f);

}

@keyframes glow{

        0%{

        box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(176,141,87,.4);

        }

        50%{

        box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(176,141,87,.9);

        }

        100%{

        box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(176,141,87,.4);

}
}
